summary: Implemented rich.progress open and wrap_file (module-level and Progress methods) with a private reader and context wrapper, plus tests, docs, and a changelog entry. Nothing committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run; all verification was by reading. Known open item: _ProgressFileReader.readinto calls handle.readinto, which typing.BinaryIO lacks, so mypy will likely flag it; left unsuppressed per spec. Other judgment calls: raw mode 'tr' returns binary per spec; added a mode: str fallback overload on both open entry points; the module-level open shadows the builtin, so the new code uses io.open.
